1.title: SMANSA Parti - AI Smart School Assistant
1.shortDesc: Web-based school information system equipped with an intelligent Virtual Assistant (Chatbot) for 24-hour information services.
1.fullDesc: A digital platform designed for SMA Negeri 1 Pati (SMANSA) to simplify information access for students and parents. Its main feature is an AI-based Chatbot that can automatically answer questions about the school. Equipped with an Admin dashboard to train the bot's 'Knowledge Base', as well as special access for the Principal to monitor information activity.
1.challenge: The biggest challenge was implementing the LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) algorithm as a newly adopted technology. During development, it was discovered that pure LSTM is only effective for 'intent' classification, but lacks the ability to construct natural and flexible answer sentences like human conversation.
1.solution: Developed a hybrid backend: LSTM for intent detection and NLP for natural text processing. On the interface side, I used Vue.js (SPA) for both the Landing Page and Admin Dashboard, creating a real-time, interactive, and seamless chat experience without page reloads.
1.result: Created an interactive school information service, reducing the school admin's burden in answering repetitive questions, and providing a modern information access experience.

2.title: BeeMart - Enterprise POS & Inventory System
2.shortDesc: Integrated inventory management and Point of Sales (POS) system for multi-outlet and supplier business operations.
2.fullDesc: A B2B web application specifically developed for company needs in digitizing daily operations. This system includes comprehensive stock management, financial transaction recording, automatic report export, and logistics order status monitoring between Outlets and Suppliers in one centralized ecosystem.
2.challenge: The main challenge was creating real-time data synchronization between three user roles (Admin, Supplier, Outlet) that are interdependent. Additionally, developing the complex 'Stock Opname' feature required strict validation logic to ensure physical vs system data accuracy.
2.solution: Designed a complex relational database structure to map custom business flows. Used Laravel as a robust backend to handle heavy transaction logic, and Vue.js on the frontend for a responsive and interactive user experience without excessive page reloads.
2.result: The system was successfully implemented to reduce administrative time, minimize stock discrepancies (human error) through digital opname features, and provide real-time order data transparency.

3.title: Portfolio Website
3.shortDesc: Personal portfolio website showcasing skills in React and Tailwind, along with featured projects.
3.fullDesc: A personal portfolio website designed to showcase professional identity, skills, and featured projects. Built with a focus on performance, modern aesthetics, and seamless user experience.
3.challenge: Creating a unique and personal yet professional design, while ensuring the website is responsive across all devices.
3.solution: Used React for modular component structure and Tailwind CSS for fast and consistent styling. Implemented smooth animations with Framer Motion for a premium feel.
3.result: A fast, responsive portfolio website that successfully attracts potential clients and recruiters.

4.title: E-Mufassir
4.shortDesc: e-Mufassir is a Muslim assistant web app, helping users find information about the Quran, Hadith, and Fiqh.
4.fullDesc: A comprehensive platform providing easy access to trusted Islamic sources. Includes verse search, tafsir, hadith, and fiqh article features.
4.challenge: Integrating various data sources (Quran API, Hadith) and presenting them in an interface easily understood by general users.
4.solution: Built a strong backend with Laravel for data management and Vue.js frontend for responsive interaction. Used Python for Arabic text data processing.
4.result: A platform that helps thousands of users learn about Islam more easily and in a structured way.

5.title: Chatbot E-Mufassir
5.shortDesc: This chatbot is the result of my undergraduate thesis, designed to find information about the content of Tafsir Al-Azhar.
5.fullDesc: An AI-based virtual assistant that allows users to ask about Tafsir Al-Azhar using natural language. This project is part of my thesis research.
5.challenge: Processing natural language questions (NLP) and accurately matching them with relevant tafsir content.
5.solution: Developed an NLP model using Python and integrated it with the Telegram Bot API platform. Laravel backend was used as a webhook handler.
5.result: A chatbot capable of answering tafsir-related questions with good accuracy, making tafsir knowledge accessible to the younger generation.
